name: Mathias and the Defias
summary: SI:7 reports unusually heavy Defias activity in Westfall. You are sent to Agent Kearnen for a debriefing near an abandoned Alliance watch tower.

sections.title: The Watch Tower
sections.body: The Defias have taken over an abandoned Alliance watch tower southeast of Sentinel Hill. SI:7 reports they are using it as a base to smuggle goods from the Redridge supply route. You are sent to Westfall to find Agent Kearnen, hidden near the tower, and receive her debriefing.

faq.answer: SI:7 reports unusually heavy Defias activity in Westfall. The Defias have taken over an abandoned Alliance watch tower and use it to smuggle goods from the Redridge supply route.
The Defias have taken over an abandoned Alliance watch tower southeast of Sentinel Hill.
Agent Kearnen is the SI:7 agent you are sent to find near the tower for a debriefing.

faq.q: What does SI:7 want me to do?
faq.answer: SI:7 sends you to Westfall to find Agent Kearnen, who is hidden near the tower, for a debriefing.
The Defias are smuggling goods from the Redridge supply route.

angles.text: The Defias have taken an abandoned Alliance watch tower in Westfall and use it as a smuggling base.
